basic_details.job_title: IFFCO Trainee- Diploma Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IFFCO Trainee- Diploma (Chemical) is a one-year training post at the Phulpur Unit of Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Limited (IFFCO), Prayagraj, on a monthly consolidated stipend of Rs 31,000 plus applicable allowances as per rules. Eligible Diploma (Chemical) holders who have completed an apprenticeship can apply online at careers.iffco-recruitments.in until 02.12.2026, under advertisement PA/02/Estt/Rect/2026 dated 30/10/2026.

qualification.details: Full-time regular Diploma (Chemical) from AICTE recognized institutions, with minimum 60% marks for General/OBC candidates and minimum 55% marks for SC/ST candidates. Apprenticeship done in the relevant trade, preferably from any Chemical/Fertiliser Plant. A certificate of completion of apprenticeship issued by the Apprenticeship Board (BOAT). Candidates admitted directly to the second year of Diploma through a recognized lateral entry scheme (Class XII Science/ITI) are also eligible, subject to the prescribed minimum percentage of marks based on the aggregate of four semesters of the Diploma course.

salary_details.details: The training period is one year, on a monthly consolidated stipend of Rs 31,000/-pm plus applicable allowances as per rules. After successful completion of training, suitable candidates may be absorbed in the regular pay scale of Rs. 34000-64000 along with other allowances as per rules of IFFCO. | At the time of joining, trainees have to furnish a bond to serve IFFCO for a minimum period of three years after the training period. The bond is Rs. 25,000/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs.6500/- for SC/ST candidates. | The place of posting is IFFCO Phulpur Unit. During the training period, the candidate may be posted or deployed at any of the Plants of IFFCO for training, as per requirement of Management.

selection_process: Document Verification and Medical Examination. The exact date
time and venue of the online examination and the admit card will be informed through Email/SMS. The notice does not give the exam pattern
how_to_apply: Open the application link for IFFCO Trainee- Diploma (Chemical) given in the notice and fill in the online application form, including personal details, carefully and accurately.
Write the name, father's name and date of birth exactly as recorded in the Matriculation (10th) or equivalent certificate.
Give an active mobile number and a valid e-mail ID and keep them active during the entire engagement process. Messages are sent by e-mail or SMS, and e-mails are treated as deemed to have been read.
Submit the application on or before 02.12.2026.
Do not send a hard copy of the application form at this stage. If IFFCO asks for any document for further verification of eligibility, it is to be sent by e-mail.

For issues with the form or application, use the Technical Support tab in the online application, or call Helpline No. 7508309300 or 0581-240-4102/4106, or write to [email protected], from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on all working days.
Diploma Mark Sheets (all semesters) and Diploma Certificate
Apprenticeship Certificate indicating the contract number and trade details
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. If any document, including mark sheets, educational certificates or caste certificates, is found false, forged or fabricated at any stage or even after joining, the candidature will be cancelled or, in the event of appointment, the services are liable for termination. Communication to shortlisted candidates is sent through E-mail or SMS on the mobile number given in the application form. IFFCO reserves the right, at its sole discretion and subject to applicable laws, to modify, postpone, reschedule, suspend or cancel the recruitment process, and to increase, decrease or withdraw any or all of the notified vacancies, without assigning any reason or prior notice. Submitting an application or taking part in the selection process gives no right to selection or appointment.

content_sections.heading: About IFFCO Phulpur Unit
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Phulpur Unit of Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Limited, located at P.O. Ghiyanagar, Phulpur, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. It is signed by the Dy. General Manager (Personnel & Administration), IFFCO – Phulpur Unit. The place of posting is IFFCO Phulpur Unit.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Full-time regular Diploma (Chemical) from AICTE recognized institutions, with minimum 60% marks for General/OBC candidates and minimum 55% marks for SC/ST candidates. Apprenticeship done in the relevant trade, preferably from any Chemical/Fertiliser Plant. A certificate of completion of apprenticeship issued by the Apprenticeship Board (BOAT). Candidates admitted directly to the second year of Diploma through a recognized lateral entry scheme (Class XII Science/ITI) are also eligible, subject to the prescribed minimum percentage of marks based on the aggregate of four semesters of the Diploma course. The age limit is Minimum 18 years and Maximum 27 Years as on 01.11.2026. Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time / correspondence / distance education mode are not eligible. Applications from candidates not meeting any criteria regarding qualification, age and apprenticeship will be rejected. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The training period is one year, on a monthly consolidated stipend of Rs 31,000/-pm plus applicable allowances as per rules. After successful completion of training, suitable candidates may be absorbed in the regular pay scale of Rs. 34000-64000 along with other allowances as per rules of IFFCO. At the time of joining, trainees have to furnish a bond to serve IFFCO for a minimum period of three years after the training period. The bond is Rs. 25,000/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs.6500/- for SC/ST candidates. The place of posting is IFFCO Phulpur Unit. During the training period, the candidate may be posted or deployed at any of the Plants of IFFCO for training, as per requirement of Management.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IFFCO Trainee- Diploma (Chemical)
content_sections.text: Open the application link for IFFCO Trainee- Diploma (Chemical) given in the notice and fill in the online application form, including personal details, carefully and accurately. Write the name, father's name and date of birth exactly as recorded in the Matriculation (10th) or equivalent certificate. Give an active mobile number and a valid e-mail ID and keep them active during the entire engagement process. Messages are sent by e-mail or SMS, and e-mails are treated as deemed to have been read. Submit the application on or before 02.12.2026. Do not send a hard copy of the application form at this stage. If IFFCO asks for any document for further verification of eligibility, it is to be sent by e-mail. For issues with the form or application, use the Technical Support tab in the online application, or call Helpline No. 7508309300 or 0581-240-4102/4106, or write to [email protected] , from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on all working days. 10th Mark Sheet and Certificate 12th Mark Sheet and Certificate Diploma Mark Sheets (all semesters) and Diploma Certificate Latest applicable Caste Certificate Apprenticeship Certificate indicating the contract number and trade details Aadhaar Card Recent passport-size photograph

content_sections.text: The selection stages, in order, are Online Test, Interview, Document Verification and Medical Examination. The exact date, time and venue of the online examination and the admit card will be informed through Email/SMS. The notice does not give the exam pattern, syllabus or marks.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IFFCO Trainee- Diploma (Chemical)?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of application is 02.12.2026. Applications are made online through the link given in the notice.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for IFFCO Trainee- Diploma (Chemical)?
faq.answer: A full-time regular Diploma (Chemical) from an AICTE recognized institution is required, with minimum 60% marks for General/OBC and 55% for SC/ST. Candidates also need an apprenticeship completion certificate issued by the Apprenticeship Board (BOAT).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for IFFCO Trainee- Diploma (Chemical)?
faq.answer: The age limit is Minimum 18 years and Maximum 27 Years as on 01.11.2026. SC/ST candidates get 5 years' relaxation and OBC candidates get 3 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for IFFCO Trainee- Diploma (Chemical)?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated stipend is Rs 31,000/-pm during the one-year training period, plus applicable allowances as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. Are allowances paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: The notice says the stipend of Rs 31,000/-pm is plus applicable allowances as per rules. It does not list the allowances by name.

faq.question: Q6. How is the selection done?
faq.answer: The stages are Online Test, Interview, Document Verification and Medical Examination. The date, time and venue of the online examination will be informed through Email/SMS.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a service bond?
faq.answer: Yes. At joining, trainees must furnish a bond to serve IFFCO for a minimum of three years after training. The bond is Rs. 25,000/- for General/OBC and Rs.6500/- for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent after training?
faq.answer: After successful completion of training, suitable candidates may be absorbed in the regular pay scale of Rs. 34000-64000 along with other allowances as per rules of IFFCO. Absorption is not guaranteed by the notice.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets the additional 3 years of age relaxation?
faq.answer: The additional 3 years apply to land losers whose land has been acquired by IFFCO, ex-apprentices of IFFCO, and dependents of deceased IFFCO employees who expired during service.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to send a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No hard copy of the application form is required at this stage. If IFFCO asks for any document for further verification, it must be sent by e-mail.
